kdf: HMAC-SHA256 with the 32 raw master bytes as key and each exact UTF-8 label below as message; take first 8 digest bytes, unsigned big-endian, for u64 streams
target_generation: first 8 digest bytes modulo p=4001 gives x0; scan x=x0,x0+1,... modulo p to first on-curve x, choose smallest y in [0,p); no scalar witness is supplied to the producer
prng: source-defined u64 xorshift: s ^= s<<13; s ^= s>>7; s ^= s<<17; two successive outputs give a=output mod 4019, b=1+(output mod 4018) per candidate; wrapping u64 shifts/XOR
cases: case=3*target_id+replicate_id, 0..11; candidate stream key excludes full/partial arm; each replicate stream is intentionally reused across four different target points, and both arms share the identical ordered point stream per case
rho: deterministic Floyd x mod 3 partition and fixed initial seeds 1..4, independent of coefficient streams; same rho walk intentionally repeats for a target across its three coefficient replicates
curve_selection: scan fixed ascending p list [4001,4003,4007,4013,4019,4021,4027,4049,4051,4057,4073,4091,4093,4099], skip composite p, then b=1..50 for E:y^2=x^3+x+b, first prime group order; PARI/GP 2.17.3 returned p=4001,b=27,#E=4019; first point in x/y ascending scan is G=(1,921)
arm_schedule: single fresh process per case; full-only and partial share in-memory stream, full-only executes first; no timing speed claim from this fixed order
independent_replay: regenerate all 768 candidate points and both accepted-row sets, check raw candidate bytes and exact point/source/filtered-rank/target outputs; at least one case per arm configuration must replay before reproducibility wording
